name: Warpwood Quarter
summary: In Dire Maul, twisted growth and demonic corruption now overrun the Warpwood Quarter. Once its gardens nurtured nature, but frenzied plants and corrupted satyrs have taken the eastern district of Eldre'Thalas.

sections.title: A Garden Corrupted
sections.body: The Warpwood Quarter's grand gardens are now a choking tangle of twisted ancients and lethal lashers. Alzzin the Wildshaper, a satyr, turned dark magic against the ancient Fruit of Fertility. Under his influence, the plants grew grotesque and predatory. Vile Felvine shards now saturate the halls, where demons, rebellious imps and demonic thralls have gathered.

sections.title: Pathways through the Overgrowth
sections.body: Most explorers enter the district through Dire Maul's central Broken Commons. To the east, an overgrown passage runs beneath the Lariss Pavilion, though Alzzin's warped guardians make the way dangerous. The mischievous imp Pusillin brings another peril. His thievery sends pursuers racing toward secluded reaches of the ruins.

faq.answer: The Warpwood Quarter is Dire Maul's eastern district, within the ancient Highborne city of Eldre'Thalas. Demonic energies have overrun and changed its grand conservatories.

The satyr Alzzin the Wildshaper rules the quarter. He has used fell energies to corrupt the local plants and the legendary Fruit of Fertility, turning the district's plant guardians into vicious warped ancients.

faq.q: How do you enter the Warpwood Quarter?
aliases: how to get to dire maul east
faq.answer: You can enter from the Broken Commons inside Dire Maul. A second, secluded passage beneath the Lariss Pavilion in eastern Feralas requires a Crescent Key to unlock.

faq.q: Why is the imp Pusillin running through the ruins?
faq.answer: Pusillin is a thieving imp who lurks near the quarter's entrance. When trespassers confront him, he taunts them and flees deeper into the ruins, mocking them as he runs toward the Hidden Reach.

angles.text: As a druid, you see the twisted fate of the Warpwood ancients and the Fruit of Fertility's corruption into foul Felvine as affronts to Cenarion teachings. Druids from Moonglade seek to cleanse the quarter.
As a night elf, you see Eldre'Thalas's majestic conservatories perverted into a satyr den. Their ruin recalls the corruption that brought down the ancient Highborne Empire.
